note: Only one widely catalogued chèo release could be verified, the 1976 UNESCO album, so this is a short list; quan họ shares chèo's northern folk-song roots.

size.basis: Chèo has roughly 200 traditional melodies (172 collected by Trần Vinh) and only about seven surviving classic plays, recorded mostly by state troupes, Vietnamese radio and domestic CD/VCD labels; each melody and famous play excerpt exists in several singers' versions, giving hundreds to a few thousand recordings, of which the classic-play excerpts and best-known melodies sung by the senior masters (a few dozen) would be called essential.
